title: Decentralized Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization with Client-Data Sampling
summary: This paper studies decentralized nonsmooth nonconvex optimization with Lipschitz-continuous local functions. We propose an efficient stochastic first-order method with a novel client-data sampling strategy in which the mini-batch sizes of the stochastic gradients on all clients follow a multinomial distribution. We show that our method can find a $(δ,ε)$-Goldstein stationary point on each client with the best-known dependence on $ε$~and $δ$ in both computational and communication complexity.
